verses.gurmukhi: ਸਵੈਯਾ: ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਪਤੰਗ ਚਰਾਚਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit_en: savaiyaa: khag mirag meen pata(n)g charaachar jon anek bikhai bhram aaio ||

en.bdb: Swaiye: A living being has wandered in many species of birds, animals, fish, insects, root and conscious beings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲ ਭੂ-ਤਲ ਦੇਵਪੁਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਲਉ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit_en: sun sun pai rasaatal bhoo-tal dhevapuree prat lau bahu dhaio ||

en.bdb: He wandered in the nether regions, earth and heaven in order to practice whatever sermons he had heard.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਹੂ ਭੋਗ ਦੁਖਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਾਦਿਕ ਧਰਮ ਅਧਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit_en: jog hoo bhog dhukhaadh sukhaadhik dharam adharam sukaram kamaio ||

en.bdb: He kept performing good and bad deeds bearing the comforts and sufferings of various practices of Yoga.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਆਇ॥ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪੨੨॥
verses.translit_en: haar pario saranaagat aai|| guroo mukh dhekh garoo sukh paio ||422||

en.bdb: He got tired going through these countless rigours of many births and then comes to the refuge of the True Guru. By adopting and accepting the teachings of the True Guru and beholding His glimpse, he is able to achieve the great spiritual comfort and peace.  (422)
